headline: DeadLands Rages On; Weathered Expanse Slumbers
war_summary: Since the last bulletin the battle line has remained in motion. DeadLands is again the hottest ground, with four strategic-base events in the final two-hour window; Callahan's Boot, the day's busiest point, still shows no sign of settling. MarbanHollow has flared around Mox, printing two events in the same period. Stlican Shelf, lively at the previous edition, has quieted in the last two hours after five events in the six-hour returns, with Vulpine Watch and The Old Mourn leading the day's totals. Stonecradle, previously without fresh flips, has stirred: three events in six hours and casualty rates sharply accelerating. King's Cage also posted fresh movement, its last change coming from Den of Knaves. Weathered Expanse remains dormant, no event since 19:53, though its twenty-four-hour total stands at twenty-four. Callahan's Passage has yet to record a new strategic-base flip, but its casualty ledgers gained 176 Colonials and 169 Wardens in two hours. No victory has been declared.
